snippet.title: Sports Goofy - Atari 5200 Prototype Gameplay
snippet.description:
You know how we were supposed to get four Disney games on the Atari 2600, but the collaboration was cut short, with only one getting a commercial release? It seems this extends to the 5200, as Sports Goofy was intended to be released in 1983. In fact, this would have been the ONLY Disney game to be on the 5200, had it been fully released.

Goofy, Sports Goofy (C) Disney
